summary: Amtech Systems, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Titan Partners Group LLC for an underwritten public offering of 2,926,829 common shares at $20.50 per share, raising ~$60M gross proceeds. The offering closed on June 3, 2026 under an existing S-3 shelf and an additional S-3MEF. A 60-day lock-up applies to the company and insiders. This is a routine capital raise via an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special-situation event. No activist, acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review elements are present.
